component-anonymity-crowd-intro: A <glossary>shielded pool</glossary> is a shared contract that hides who paid whom. It can't make you invisible. It hides you among everyone else who uses it, a group called the anonymity set. The bigger that crowd, the harder it is to tell which person made a withdrawal.
component-anonymity-crowd-instructions: Change the size of the crowd, then switch on the habits below to see how much cover is left.
component-anonymity-crowd-canvas-label: A crowd of dots, one of them you
component-anonymity-crowd-dot-scale-many: {count, plural, one {Each dot is about # person} other {Each dot is about # people}}
component-anonymity-crowd-habit-amount-l: The same unusual amount goes in and comes out
component-anonymity-crowd-habit-amount-d: For example, {amount} deposited and exactly {amount} withdrawn
component-anonymity-crowd-habit-timing-l: The withdrawal comes ten minutes after the deposit
component-anonymity-crowd-habit-timing-d: Only people who deposited in that window still cover you
component-anonymity-crowd-verdict-alone: A pool with one person in it hides nobody. Everyone knows the withdrawal was you.
component-anonymity-crowd-verdict-habits: Everyone else just stepped out of the crowd. The pool is still big, but these habits made your crowd tiny.
{count, plural, one {The pool is still big, but these habits leave only # person who could be you.} other {The pool is still big, but these habits leave only # people who could be you.}}
component-anonymity-crowd-verdict-small: A small crowd. Anyone watching can check each person one by one.
component-anonymity-crowd-verdict-large: A crowd this size is real cover, as long as habits like these don't give you away.
component-anonymity-crowd-caption: A simplified model. It assumes about 1 in {amountRatio} deposits match an unusual amount and about 1 in {timingRatio} land within ten minutes of yours. Real pools vary, and analysts use more clues than these two.
component-anonymity-crowd-takeaway: Privacy is a team sport. Every person who joins makes everyone else harder to find.
